cues: A woman admits that she once tried to be what men wanted her to be.
At the end of the poem, the old order prepares a grand ceremony to honour her, and she simply does not turn up.
text: A woman admits that she once tried to be what men wanted her to be. Then she starts walking. At the end of the poem, the old order prepares a grand ceremony to honour her, and she simply does not turn up.
